name: keep-coding
description: Evidence-gated durable memory with assumption tracking and bounded correction for long-running coding agents.

interface.shortDescription: Keep large agent projects coherent, efficient, and verified.
interface.longDescription: Turns large project prompts into adaptive durable contracts, dependency-aware phases, assumption-linked artifacts, bounded correction blast radii, evidence-backed checkpoints, approvals, budgets, delta context delivery, and resumable cross-runtime state.
defaultPrompt: Build this project end to end and keep every phase verified.
Continue the active project from its latest checkpoint without retransmitting unchanged context.
